slice_options.advantage: directly follows from the ambient deformation F_eps(x)=x+eps A x
slice_options.risk: contains a Lie-derivative part that should be pure coordinate change, but can contaminate a truncated or improperly projected trace

slice_options.advantage: keeps only the geometric normal/shape part after removing coordinate reparametrization
slice_options.risk: valid only if the determinant, zero/gauge factors and coexact projection are invariant under the removed Lie-derivative direction

conditions_to_drop_lie_part.meaning: L(2,1) has no boundary, so pure coordinate variations should not create boundary terms.
The determinant regularization and local counterterms must respect coordinate invariance.
The transverse/coexact slice must be transported consistently under coordinate changes, not kept fixed as a coordinate subspace.
Gauge and zero-mode factors must not reintroduce a finite contribution from the removed coordinate direction.
The Lie-derivative part may drop only in the full trace or in a symmetry-respecting finite calculation, not after arbitrary shell truncation.

allowed_working_rule.rule: Use h_A^red=2 q_A g for the C6 finite deformation trace only as a diffeomorphism-reduced representative.
allowed_working_rule.must_state: The Hess(q_A)=L_{grad(q_A)/2}g part is not discarded dynamically; it is quotiented as an infinitesimal coordinate reparametrization.
allowed_working_rule.failure_mode: If the coexact determinant calculation is not invariant under this reparametrization, the raw strain must be used and C6 rank-10 collapse must be recomputed.

impact_on_next_matrix_elements.then: matrix elements are driven by q_A times local conformal variation of the one-form Laplacian plus normalization terms
impact_on_next_matrix_elements.benefit: the deformation space is visibly ell=0 plus ell=2, matching P02

impact_on_next_matrix_elements.then: matrix elements must include Hess(q_A) derivative couplings explicitly
impact_on_next_matrix_elements.benefit: fully safe geometrically, but harder and may spread trace over more shell couplings

verdict: The conformal representative h_A^red=2 q_A g may be used only as a diffeomorphism-reduced slice, not as an unexplained deletion of Hess(q_A). This is conditionally justified on closed L(2,1) if determinant regularization, coexact projection, and zero/gauge separation are all coordinate-covariant. If any of these conditions fail, the raw induced strain h_A=2<u,A v> must be used for the matrix elements.
